summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with Stan Tat scoring the decisive goal in the first half. The Bach secured all three points with a solid defensive performance, keeping a clean sheet against a resilient opponent. Following the opening day success, Stan Tat has already attracted sponsorship from Calibre Control, recognising his match-winning contribution.
